French Crypto Worker’s Family Kidnapped at Home, Four Suspects Flee According to BFMTV, a crypto industry worker, his wife and their two children, aged 8 and 12, were kidnapped and restrained at their home in Vendin-le-Vieil, France. Investigators are considering whether the incident was linked to an attempt to obtain cryptocurrency. The man and his daughter were assaulted, he contacted emergency services at around 8:00 a.m. on Sunday, and the four suspects fled. The amount of any loss remains unknown. — link

Goldman Sachs, Citizens: SEC Innovation Exemption Framework Could Benefit Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the SEC’s five-year “innovation exemption” framework could benefit Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle by allowing qualifying tokenized U.S. stocks to trade through AMMs on public blockchains. Coinbase could benefit from custody, tokenization infrastructure, stablecoins and Base; Robinhood would need to add full shareholder rights to its offshore stock-token products; Circle could benefit from greater demand for USDC settlement and collateral. Trading limits, issuer opt-out rights and AMM constraints could limit the impact on traditional exchanges. — link
